extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who want to create a new Wikipedia page: account and confirmation requirements, checks to avoid duplication, and procedural steps (use draft/article wizard, check deletion log, handle redirects and capitalization).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review or request a new article. This is a procedural requirement before direct article creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft as an alternative
rubrics_metrics.description: If you cannot create an article directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed), use the article wizard or submit a draft for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatives include using the article wizard to create a draft or requesting a new article so experienced editors can review/assist; this helps prevent low-quality or promotional pages from being created directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles, alternative titles, and spellings first
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for the exact title and check alternative titles or spellings before creating a new page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for existing articles that might cover the topic under a different name; avoid duplicating content. Use the search box and check related pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for existing links and redirects (What links here)
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to the desired title to determine if the topic is already covered or where a redirect should point.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'What links here' tool to find mentions and to decide whether to create a new page or add content to an existing one.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if a page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page with the title was deleted, consult the deletion log to find out why.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review 'Why was the page I created deleted?' and the deletion log to learn past reasons for deletion before attempting to recreate the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia titles are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify correct capitalization to avoid duplicate titles and create redirects as needed so users searching different capitalizations find the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for update delays and try purging if newly created pages don't appear
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created it may not be visible immediately because of database update delays; try waiting a few minutes or using the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot see a recently created page, wait a short time or use the purge function to force an update; this addresses propagation delays rather than content problems.
